review.inventory_exclusion_assessment: No exclusions: all five changed Python sources were inspected; the only changed test source contains four cases, all mapped to the accepted test plan, with no unmapped cases.

criteria.assessment: Fresh installation leaves root AGENTS.md absent, loads the same kit-owned workflow in both editors on successful preflight, and instructs both runtimes to stop and report the blocked path when access fails.

e2e.assessment: The disposable Git client invokes the installed Cursor and nested-directory Codex handlers, checks both native response envelopes on success and failure, and verifies the Cursor fallback rule.

criteria.assessment: First install and force reinstall preserve client instructions and unrelated editor hooks, retain handler order, and leave one AskIt startup entry per editor. Unsupported Codex hook configuration is rejected transactionally with prior bytes intact and no partial runtime publication.

e2e.assessment: CWH-T02 exercises ordinary and force installation over pre-existing Cursor and Codex handlers and checks preservation, ordering, and uniqueness.

integration.assessment: CWH-T03 runs through the installation transaction and checks the malformed-configuration diagnostic, unchanged input bytes, and absent runtime after refusal.

criteria.assessment: The documented upgrade from v2.0.1 loads the replacement workflow for both runtimes, preserves client instructions and unrelated handlers, and remains idempotent on a second upgrade.

tests.assertion_assessment: Asserts fresh install creates no root AGENTS.md, both installed handlers deliver the same workflow on success, Cursor fallback points to kit-owned guidance, and both native envelopes report the blocked path plus STOP on access failure.
tests.counterexample: If Cursor or Codex omitted the access failure path or STOP instruction, its failure-envelope assertions would fail; creating a root AGENTS.md also fails the install assertion.

tests.counterexample: Overwriting the Cursor registry on force install removes the client handler and fails the preservation assertion; duplicate registrations fail the exact-count assertion.
